rows.text: sells 26% of new SPV Clean Max Gangotri to Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals for a nominal Rs 26,000 and commits to subscribe up to Rs 214.49 cr of equity into the JV in tranches for Gujarat wind-solar hybrid capacity; SPA to follow by 31-Jan-2027.
step-down subsidiary signs an SPA to acquire 100% of Thailand's GSB Energy Company; consideration not disclosed.
MoU with Andhra Pradesh to invest about Rs 50,000 cr over five years in 3 GW of renewables and 1 GW of pumped storage to power a 2 GW compute factory; an MoU, not a contract.
approves the **sale of 4,900 shares, 49% of wholly owned Clean Max Dynamis, to Sunvik Steels**. Dynamis was incorporated on 28 July 2026 and contributed nothing to revenue or net worth last year.
